card.name: Period after editors in book citations
card.fires_on: The period right after "eds" at the end of an editor list in a reference citation, just before the book title. It also fires weakly on "sodium" in sulfate bowel-prep names.

modes.label: Editor list ending
modes.description: Period after "eds" closing a list of book editors, before the textbook title.
modes.example: Ginder G. Microcytic and hypochromic anemias. In: Goldman L, Schafer AI, eds<<.>> Cecil Medicine . 24th

modes.label: Sodium sulfate prep name
modes.description: The word sodium at the start of the sodium sulfate, potassium sulfate, magnesium sulfate bowel prep.
modes.example: Each dose consists of one bottle of<< sodium>> sulfate, potassium sulfate, and magnesium sulfate

modes.label: Reviewer credential comma
modes.description: Comma after a reviewer's MD in a review-credit line.
modes.example: Reviewed By: Todd Gersten, MD<<,>> Hematology/Oncology, Palm Beach
